Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us. It is Vectramind Internet Applications Company's policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect from you across our website and other sites we own and operate.

We only ask for personal information when we truly need it to provide a service to you. We collect it by fair and lawful means, with your knowledge and consent. We also let you know why we're collecting it and how it will be used.

We only retain collected information for as long as necessary to provide you with your requested service. What data we store, we'll protect within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorised access, disclosure, copying, use or modification. We don't share any personally identifying information publicly or with third-parties, except when required to by law.

Our website may link to external sites that are not operated by us. Please be aware that we have no control over the content and practices of these sites, and cannot accept responsibility or liability for their respective privacy policies. You are free to refuse our request for your personal information, with the understanding that we may be unable to provide you with some of your desired services.

Your continued use of our website will be regarded as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, feel free to contact us.

This policy is effective as of 10 May 2024.

Last update March 2024

MOBILE APP Privacy Policy: fpEngage Healthcare Live Agent

Vectramind Health ("we", "us", or "our") operates the [fpEngage] mobile application (the "App").

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our fpEngage App. Please read it carefully. By using the App, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

If you do not agree, please do not use the fpEngage App.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

A. Information You Provide Directly

  • Account information (e.g., name, email address, phone number) when you create an account or sign in.
  • User-generated content (e.g., posts, comments, photos, messages) if the App includes these features.
  • Payment information (processed securely via third-party providers; we do not store full card details).
  • Patient support communications.

B. Information Collected Automatically

  • Device information: Device type, OS version, unique device identifiers, IP address, mobile carrier.
  • Usage data: App features used, time spent, crash logs, performance metrics.
  • Location data: Approximate or precise location (only if you grant permission and the feature requires it).
  • Analytics & advertising identifiers (e.g., IDFA on iOS, AAID on Android).

C. Information from Third Parties

  • Data from login providers (Google, Apple, Facebook) if you use social sign-in.
  • Analytics/ad partners (e.g., Google Analytics, Firebase, Meta Ads).

We do not collect sensitive personal data (health, biometric, racial/ethnic origin) unless explicitly stated and consented to, for a specific feature.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to:

  • Provide, maintain, and improve the fpEngage App and its features.
  • Personalize your experience.
  • Communicate with you (updates, support, marketing — only with consent where required).
  • Analyze usage and trends to enhance performance.
  • Detect/prevent fraud, security issues, or policy violations.
  • Comply with legal obligations.
  • Serve contextual (non-personalized) or personalized ads (if applicable).
3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR-relevant regions)
  • Performance of a contract (to deliver App services).
  • Legitimate interests (analytics, security, improvements).
  • Consent (marketing, certain tracking, precise location).
  • Legal obligation (e.g., retaining transaction data).
4. Sharing Your Information

We share information only in these cases:

  • With service providers (hosting, analytics, payment processors, cloud services) bound by confidentiality.
  • With advertising/measurement partners (if ads are shown).
  • In business transfers (merger, acquisition).
  • To comply with law, protect rights/safety, or respond to legal requests.
  • With your consent or at your direction.

We do not sell your personal information.

5. Data Storage & Security
  • Data is stored on secure servers (primarily in [region, e.g., EU/US]).
  • We use industry-standard measures (encryption in transit/rest, access controls).
  • No method is 100% secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Retention — We keep data only as long as needed for the purposes above or legal requirements (typically [X months/years] after last use, unless longer retention is required).

6. International Data Transfers

If you are outside [primary storage region], your data may transfer to and be processed in other countries with different privacy rules. We use appropriate safeguards (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses for EEA/UK users).

7. Your Rights & Choices

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data.
  • Withdraw consent (where processing is consent-based).
  • Opt out of marketing or certain tracking.
  • Request data portability.
  • Object to processing.
  • Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

To exercise rights: Contact us at [your-email@domain.com]. We respond within legally required timeframes (e.g., 30–45 days).

Opt-out options

  • Device settings → limit ad tracking (iOS: App Tracking Transparency; Android: opt-out of interest-based ads).
  • Do Not Sell/Share signals (for CCPA/CPRA users) — we honor Global Privacy Control where implemented.

Account deletion — Request via in-app settings or by emailing us; we delete or anonymize data except legally required retention.

8. Children's Privacy

The fpEngage is not intended for children under 13 (or 16 in some jurisdictions). We do not knowingly collect data from children under age limits without verifiable parental consent per COPPA and similar laws.

If we learn we have collected such data, we delete it promptly.

9. Third-Party Links & Services

The fpEngage App may link to or integrate third-party services (e.g., social media, payment gateways). Their privacy practices govern once you leave our App. We are not responsible for their policies.

10. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this policy. Changes will be posted here with an updated "Last updated" date. Material changes may include in-app notice or email (if we have your contact). Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

11. Contact Us

For questions about this Privacy Policy or your data:

Mobile App privacy policy: Grievance Management Application

Product: Grievance Management Application (Admin & Level 1 User / Personal Secretary) Vectramind Corporation ("we", "us", or "our") operates the Grievance Management Application (the "App"), which enables public grievances submitted via WhatsApp to be tracked, managed, and resolved by Level 1 Users (Personal Secretaries) and Admins (MLA office). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard information when the App is used. By using the App, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

If you do not agree, please do not use the SynPall App.

1. Information We Collect

A. Information You Provide Directly

  • Account information (name, phone number, email address) for Admin and Level 1 User login.
  • Profile information (profile picture, name, phone number) managed via the Profile page.
  • Grievance details submitted by citizens via WhatsApp, including complaint description, town/village, and ward number.
  • Attachments (images, videos, or files) uploaded in support of a grievance, in accordance with Meta's media guidelines.
  • Customer/citizen support communications exchanged during grievance resolution. We do not collect Aadhar Number or any national identity number as part of this application.

B. Information Collected Automatically

  • Device information: device type, OS version, unique device identifiers, IP address.
  • Usage data: app features used, session activity, crash logs, and performance metrics. We do not use the App to serve advertising, and we do not use advertising identifiers (IDFA/AAID).

C. Information from Third Parties

  • Grievance data received via the Meta WhatsApp Business Platform, through which citizens submit complaints.
  • Data exchanged with backend systems used to route, assign, and track grievances (e.g., departmental/sub-departmental routing systems). We do not collect sensitive personal data (health, biometric, racial/ethnic origin) through this App.

We do not collect sensitive personal data (health, biometric, racial/ethnic origin) unless explicitly stated and consented to for a specific feature.

2. How We Use Your Information
  • To register grievances and route them to the correct department or sub-department.
  • To allow Level 1 Users to view, act on, close, or transfer assigned grievances.
  • To allow Admins to monitor overall grievance status, progress, and reporting/statistics.
  • To maintain dashboards showing new, in-progress, resolved, and delayed grievance counts.
  • To authenticate Admin and Level 1 User accounts and manage login/profile functions.
  • To detect and prevent fraud, misuse, or security issues.
  • To comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations.
3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR-relevant regions)
  • Performance of a public function (registering and resolving citizen grievances).
  • Legitimate interests (operational monitoring, security, service improvement).
  • Consent (where required for optional features, such as profile picture upload).
  • Legal obligation (recordkeeping for grievance redressal accountability).
4. Sharing Your Information

We share information only in the following circumstances:

  • With the relevant government department or sub-department responsible for resolving a grievance.
  • With service providers (hosting, cloud infrastructure) bound by confidentiality obligations.
  • With the Meta WhatsApp Business Platform, solely to enable grievance submission and status updates.
  • To comply with law, protect rights and safety, or respond to lawful government/legal requests. We do not sell personal information, and we do not share it with advertising or marketing partners.
5. Data Storage & Security
  • Data is stored on secure servers, with access restricted to authorized Admin and Level 1 User roles.
  • Industry-standard security measures are used, including encryption in transit and access controls.
  • ●No method of storage or transmission is 100% secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security. Retention: Grievance records and related personal data are retained as long as needed to resolve the grievance and to meet recordkeeping/accountability requirements for public grievance redressal, after which data may be archived or anonymized in line with applicable regulations.
6. Your Rights & Choices

Depending on applicable law, Admins, Level 1 Users, and citizens who raise grievances may have rights to:

  • Access, correct, or request deletion of their personal data.
  • Withdraw consent, where processing is consent-based (e.g., optional profile picture).
  • Object to processing or request data portability, where applicable.
  • Lodge a complaint with a relevant supervisory or grievance-redressal authority. To exercise these rights, contact us at [support-email@domain.com]. We aim to respond within legally required timeframes. Account/profile deletion: Level 1 Users and Admins may request account deletion via their Profile page or by contacting support; we delete or anonymize data except where retention is legally required.
7. Children's Privacy

The App is intended for use by authorized Admin and Level 1 User personnel and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect data from children under the applicable age of consent through this App.

8. Third-Party Links & Services

The App integrates with the Meta WhatsApp Business Platform to receive and respond to grievances. Meta's own privacy practices govern data once it is processed on their platform, and we are not responsible for their policies.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted here with an updated "Last updated" date. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

11. Contact Us
